title: Weapons of banishment
description: Weapons to imprison those unworthy of death. (EARLY BETA)
body:
WARNING: SUPER SUPER EARLY BETA

Adds weapons capable of more than just killing to your world. High capacity for griefing and trolling, use on public servers at your own peril.  

Adds the _blade of binding_ to the game. When used in combat, upon dropping an entity to 1 or 0 hit points it restores them to 1 heart and locks them in place with the bound effect for 60 seconds

content coming in 0.3.0: arrow of entombment

content coming hopefully by 1.0.0: more weapons, including one capable of "demibanning" players by locking them in spectator mode or a Tartarus-esc dimention

Made with MCreator https://mcreator.net/
